title: Comparison of corneal endothelial cell loss during manual small-incision cataract surgery using viscoelastic-assisted nucleus removal versus continuous balanced salt solution plus technique - Randomized controlled trial

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 License'); not CC BY, record kept private

indication: Cataract with nuclear sclerosis grade 1-5, with or without pseudoexfoliation (15/204), controlled diabetes (37/204) or hypertension (31/204), age 40-80 years (Table 1); subluxated or dislocated nucleus, hard mature cataract, other ocular pathology, previous ocular surgery, preoperative pachymetry above the inclusion maximum, ECD below 1500 cells/mm2, pupil below 6 mm and AC depth below 2.5 mm excluded

groups.description: Group 1 (OVD): MSICS (7-mm scleral tunnel, 7-8 mm capsulorhexis, rigid PMMA IOL, intracameral moxifloxacin) with nucleus delivery assisted by 2% HPMC viscoelastic; single surgeon; moxifloxacin, carboxymethylcellulose and tapering difluprednate for 6 weeks
Group 2 (BSS plus): the same MSICS with nucleus delivery assisted by continuous BSS plus irrigation

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 5a row 'Mean±SD (µm)', column Preoperative Group 1 (OVD)); pachymetry of the noncontact specular microscope (SP-2000P, Topcon)
series.notes: Table 5a columns follow the header order Preoperative G1/G2, 1 day G1/G2, 1 month (day 30) G1/G2; day 1 and day 30 converted from days; mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 5a row 'Mean±SD (µm)', column Preoperative Group 2 (BSS plus)); pachymetry of the noncontact specular microscope (SP-2000P, Topcon)
series.notes: Table 5a columns follow the header order Preoperative G1/G2, 1 day G1/G2, 1 month (day 30) G1/G2; day 1 and day 30 converted from days; mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.reason: Changes of the same series and p-values; the absolute CCT series is used

exclusions.what: Tables 2, 3, 4a, 4b and 5b (visual acuity, IOP, keratometry, ECD)

notes: Randomized controlled trial (computer-generated binary randomization, masked postoperative examiners), single surgeon, 204 patients (103 and 101), January 2018 to 2021.

Role: two MSICS nucleus-delivery techniques compared without an investigational agent or a declared experimental arm (viscoexpression described as well documented, BSS plus chosen as the alternative); both control, consistent with the endothelium record of this article.
The postoperative visits are day 1 and day 30 (Methods, Abstract and caption); the Table 5a header says '1 month'. Day 30 is converted as 30 days.

Methods once name BSS plus for both groups; the surgical-technique paragraph and Table 1 assign HPMC viscoelastic to Group 1 and BSS plus to Group 2, which is used here. The Discussion swaps the group sizes (101 and 103); Table 1 and Methods give 103 for Group 1 and 101 for Group 2.

Method: Methods list CCT next to the noncontact SP-2000P specular microscope and state that the pachymeter readings were taken when the cell borders appeared well defined on the monitor, i.e. specular-microscope pachymetry; the CCT device is not named separately. Flagged for review.
The Results text repeats the Table 5a means; one standard deviation in the text differs from the table (text typo); the table cells are cited.
